tagline: Inspire the World, Create the Future
hero_kpi_rationale: Samsung positions its mobile and Knox security solutions as critical infrastructure for the digital transformation of financial services, supporting 80% of the largest U.S. financial institutions. This verticalized B2B strategy represents a structural growth driver beyond consumer hardware.

kpis.name: Coverage of major U.S. financial institutions
kpis.explanation: Percentage of the largest U.S. financial institutions (by total assets) using Samsung solutions.
kpis.description: Samsung equips 80% of the largest U.S. financial institutions according to the National Information Center list (September 2023), demonstrating major penetration in this strategic vertical.
kpis.signal: Dominant position in the U.S. financial sector

kpis.name: Enterprises using Knox
kpis.explanation: Number of enterprises worldwide that have deployed the Samsung Knox security platform.
kpis.description: Over 30,000 enterprises across more than 100 countries use Samsung Knox for their security objectives, solidifying Samsung's position in enterprise mobile security.

kpis.name: Global R&D centers
kpis.explanation: Number of research and development centers operated by Samsung worldwide.
kpis.description: Samsung operates 41 R&D centers globally, supporting its continuous innovation and leadership position in active patents in the United States and Europe.

kpis.name: Consumer demand for unified experience
kpis.explanation: Percentage of consumers expecting consistent information across mobile, online, and physical channels.
kpis.description: 83% of consumers demand a seamless experience across all channels (Consumer Banking Report 2024), justifying Samsung's investments in financial mobility solutions.

kpis.name: Demand for personalization (18-54 years)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of 18-54 year-old customers wanting personalized recommendations based on their banking behaviors.
kpis.description: 70% of 18-54 year-olds expect personalized experiences (Consumer Banking Report 2024), creating demand for AI-powered capabilities embedded in Samsung devices.

ai_positioning.summary: Samsung is pursuing a strategy of integrating AI into its enterprise solutions, particularly through Knox and DeX, leveraging partnerships (Microsoft) to deliver AI-powered security and productivity features. The focus is on on-device attestation, Zero Trust security, and enhancing workflows in vertical sectors such as finance.
evidence: Partnership with Microsoft on the first on-device attestation solution for enterprise (July 2023)
Integration of AI-based security capabilities in Knox for real-time protection
Deployment of DeX to enable AI-optimized mobile desktop experiences
